recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless PA creates a new tracker to change the string datatype or define a separate description search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-20188 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked to add a description/notes field to Endpoint and enable description-text search; the final resolution added only Endpoint.description string 0..1 and rejected a standard description search parameter.
initial_application: Commit 785c8abadf204bc369686be753ee1db3bb5f13f6 added Endpoint.description to source/endpoint/structuredefinition-Endpoint.xml and added a description value to source/endpoint/endpoint-example.xml. A later QA commit adjusted only the definition grammar/punctuation.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Endpoint search-parameter bundle contains name and payload-profile searches but no description search, matching the FHIR-20188 resolution. Later FHIR-47620 addressed Endpoint purpose discovery with a structured payload-profile search rather than reversing the no-description-search decision. A Zulip search found one 2022 PA question about whether the element should have been markdown instead of string, and no direct Confluence reference or conflicting final decision was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already satisfies the accepted FHIR-20188 change.
